import { Cron } from '@nestjs/schedule';

export class NestedBracesTask {
  constructor(private readonly jobs: any, private readonly prisma: any) {}

  @Cron('0 6 * * *')
  async tick(): Promise<void> {
    const label = `due-${JSON.stringify({ a: { b: 1 } })}`;
    if (label) {
      for (const item of [1, 2]) {
        if (item > 1) {
          await this.jobs.enqueue(`housekeeping.${item}`, { payload: { deep: { deeper: true } } });
        }
      }
    }
    // The inline work sits AFTER several closed inner blocks: a lazy match
    // would have stopped at the first closing brace and never seen it.
    await this.prisma.token.updateMany({ data: { revoked: true } });
  }

  /** Not a cron: its deleteMany must never be attributed to the cron above. */
  async manual(): Promise<void> {
    await this.prisma.token.deleteMany({});
  }
}
